dogecoin.text: So I'm not actually a reliable source for investing (got into it recently) but as someone holding dogecoin, a lot of people are pretty worried about it dropping today. This thing has staying power imo and will bounce back. If anything a low could be good for further investment.

To my fellow casual or heavy investor/cryptocurrency enthusiasts, do you think Dogecoin is being purposely sabotaged at key times? I've noticed an insane amount of panic and drops when there shouldn't be. For example, pre Elon going on SNL BOOM but 1 min before fell off a cliff.
Imagine being so desperate to be a douchebag and get a few bucks that you scalp shit. I doubled my money on dogecoin without scalping a single item and from my bedroom. Pathetic 🤣
